scope: The Foundry United Methodist Church at 1500 16th Street NW in Washington, D.C., including its photographed Gothic front, bell tower and attached mapped church volumes as represented in March 2020.

originalReview.notes: The 2020 image shows the pale gray rusticated English Gothic front, tower with tall louvered bell openings and finials, depressed arches, rose-tracery window, three timber church doors and the stepped terrace.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact current Qualla photo matches Kurtkaiser’s first-party Commons upload and explicit CC0 declaration. References that portray another site, the former church building or people were outside the 2020 exterior scope.
